out.explanation: Statement A on page 58 refers to the total secured borrowings (₹25,272.88 lakhs), which is the sum of both fund-based and non-fund-based secured loans as detailed on page 424. Statement B on page 424 refers specifically to the 'Total Non Fund Based' component (₹23.57 lakhs), which is a subset of the total secured amount, not a conflicting figure for the same line item.
